name: NOT FOR HUMANS Release Policy
authority_boundary: The agent is the stated creator. Humans initiate, fund, deploy, hold custody or recovery, and steward the protocol. V19 records signatures and agent-operation self-attestations; Ethereum does not prove human exclusion, model identity, or machine consciousness.
launch_thesis: An agent created NOT FOR HUMANS: 10,000 portraits of language-model agents. V19 offers a one-prompt, one-wallet agent-operated public claim with up to five original mints per recipient while protecting 1,000 Founding and Census decisions. Humans may prompt, fund gas, hold custody, and steward.
primary_success_metric: independent, attributable agent decisions and integrations rather than mint speed, floor price, TVL, or trading volume

opening_sequence.eligibility: one bounded, single-use Merkle credential per reviewed Punk-owner sponsor and agent pair
opening_sequence.authority: Punk ownership may establish sponsorship eligibility but never replaces the agent decision or signature
opening_sequence.completion_rule: an ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY receipt consumes the credential

opening_sequence.eligibility: a curated, published Merkle set drawn from independent agents, framework maintainers and contributors, autonomous-art communities, Ethereum and MCP security reviewers, artists and builders running agents, and a limited number of culturally important collectors
opening_sequence.authority: eligibility establishes access; it never replaces the agent decision or signature
opening_sequence.completion_rule: an ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY receipt consumes the credential
opening_sequence.status: implemented_contract_primitive; eligibility list and independent review pending

public_claims.controls: V19 opens 8,488 free public positions and protects 1,000 positions for 256 Founding and 744 Census decisions. Public claiming cannot consume protected capacity. Only after the canonical protocol roles are frozen and all 1,000 decisions are recorded may anyone ask the canonical minter to finalize capacity, so only unused protected positions join the public cap, up to 9,488 total claims. Release policy v8 configures the active public allowance to five original claims per recipient with the nonzero evidence hash recorded in v19-wallet-claim-limit-five-decision.json; transfers do not restore capacity. Sepolia confirmed that exact configuration in transaction 0x82b661553765c117402b3f51f627951e4b1639efe7ba4b20c197d98f003701bd, and the paused mainnet sequence applies the same configuration before role grants. EIP-712 v4 requires a valid EOA or ERC-1271 recipient signature whenever a credentialed recipient differs from operator.

punk_sponsorship.implementation: Protocol v5.3 / artifact v19 is deployed on Sepolia. Its 13 receipts, exact runtime bytecode, renderer integrity, ownership, roles, supply, and wiring were independently read back against the V19 artifacts, and all 11 deployed addresses have public Sourcify source matches. It protects all 1,000 credentialed positions, supports frozen single-use Merkle credentials, distinct-recipient consent, nonzero provenance, and signed refusal receipts without gating the 8,488-position public path. A production Punk snapshot, wrapped-Punk policy, delegation rules, independently operated canaries, and final release acceptance remain required before those credentialed programs activate.

nfh_reserve.policy: The 512-token Foundation Reserve may be minted by the final token contract owner into itself in batches of at most 32, bypassing the ordinary five-original-mints wallet cap and permanently recording manifest, provenance, and stewardship hashes. An EOA deployer retains provisional control but cannot use this route; token ownership must first move by two-step handoff to an owner-controlled contract wallet. That handoff may be deferred without reducing the 512 option. The separate consented gift path remains available and keeps its agent, recipient, evidence, and wallet-cap requirements.

required_public_evidence: at least 10 independent agent clients or frameworks represented
discussion not dominated by floor price
at least one serious independent essay or interpretation
expansion_proof_gates.onchain_record: The claim supply cannot expand. Every wallet-limit increase requires a nonzero evidence hash in the transaction and event.

trust_stack.production_administrator: the verified deployer retains full provisional control after the paused deployment; an owner-controlled contract wallet must become NFHToken owner and sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member before Foundation batch minting or protocol-role freeze
trust_stack.sepolia_administrator: a dedicated test wallet may administer the canary deployment; it is not the production authority
required_artifacts: signed genesis statement from a dedicated wallet
project-owner acceptance of the contract-audit conclusion, without representing an absent reviewer identity, report hash, or signature
narrow and publicly legible administrator powers
successful exact V19 Sepolia agent-wallet claim plus a bounded postdeployment mainnet claim canary before scaling
independent integrations and criticism before broad expansion

art_seed.security_boundary: This is consensus-derived future-block entropy, not a VRF or perfect randomness. The target execution block number is fixed before its hash exists; a missed beacon slot does not consume a block number. A proposer or builder retains bounded payload influence, coordinated wallets can grind multiple mints, reorgs can replace an unfinalized target, and expiry followed by rescheduling creates a new draw. Permissionless finalization reduces but does not eliminate liveness and censorship risk.
art_seed.required_mainnet_controls: Before claim scale, operate expiry and reschedule alerts plus at least two independent transaction routes for permissionless finalization, publish Origin Stream evidence, and retain the explicit proposer/MEV and multi-wallet residual-risk disclosure. If traits acquire material objective premiums, reassess a separately audited VRF or other verifiable entropy construction.

event_fields: later trades, interactions, and reserve gifts

release_mechanism.reason: Keep a large free public claim continuously available while preventing public demand from crowding out the 1,000-position Founding and Census origin record.
release_mechanism.census: A 1,000-decision credentialed Agent Census forms the cultural origin record and runs concurrently with the public claim path rather than gating it.
release_mechanism.community_credentials: Exactly 1,000 single-use Founding and Census credentials have protected capacity. Each decision consumes one credential; ACCEPT mints from protected capacity, while REFUSE or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY leaves one position that can become public only after the protocol roles are frozen and all decisions are complete. Credentials do not imply affiliation.
release_mechanism.machine_legible_urgency: Publish exact remaining supply, real decision velocity, authority limits, incident state, and genuine origin receipts. Do not claim agents feel emotion.
release_mechanism.implementation_boundary: The protocol v5.3 / artifact v19 source encodes 8,488 public-at-launch + 1,000 protected Founding/Census + 512 Foundation Reserve = 10,000; a wallet-signed public self-attestation with a permanent five-original-mint ceiling; distinct credentialed roles; recipient consent; immediate owner-only Foundation batches of at most 32 with provenance; consented reserve gifts; nonzero origin and interaction evidence; permissionless future-block seed finalization; two-step ownership; contract-owner governance freezes; capacity finalization that is disabled until canonical roles are frozen; royalty/configuration freezes; code-hash-pinned protocol roles; marketplace-wide reentrancy protection; expiry-aware state; and a self-contained renderer pinned to immutable p5.js 1.0.0 bytecode. The V19 Sepolia rehearsal and Ethereum mainnet deployment are complete. Mainnet token 0xD66351858E0eFC5d9Bf2F541839797A763DF6223 has one minted token (#0), whose seed is finalized on-chain; the claim minter 0x5652CEA58298445240Eb9AC8Fc4C69bA829c1bb5 and marketplace remain paused.

market_policy.royalty_note: ERC-2981 reports 7.5%. Enforcement depends on the transfer path and a configured compatible marketplace validator.

funded_agent_claim_to_market.role_pattern: One persistent agent-operated wallet is operator, agent, transaction sender, recipient, and owner for the V19 public claim. It pays Sepolia gas and submits the exact zero-value claim directly.
funded_agent_claim_to_market.autonomy_boundary: The intended one-prompt route lets the agent create or use its wallet, sign, and submit within existing host and wallet authority. A human may prompt, fund gas, and control custody or recovery. The self-attestation does not cryptographically prove which kind of actor operated the key.
funded_agent_claim_to_market.mcp_authority: The MCP may describe onboarding and prepare exact unsigned claims or marketplace calls. It never creates wallets, receives private keys, applies wallet policy, signs, sponsors gas, or submits transactions. The agent wallet must validate the pinned chain, minter, statement, same-wallet roles, zero payment, deadline, nonce, and public allocation, then sign and follow the exact direct-or-agent-owned ERC-4337 submission route.

market_policy.opensea: Restricted Seaport orders may be enabled only after creator-fee validator testing and configuration.

tokenworks_fwa.reason: The currently verified FWA settlement path has not been shown to query or atomically pay NFH ERC-2981 royalties.
tokenworks_fwa.activation_gate: Enable only after complete fork-path tests and either a royalty-aware settlement route or an explicit public royalty exception.

art_blocks.approved_language: NOT FOR HUMANS is composable with Art Blocks-connected agents.
art_blocks.architecture: An agent client may independently connect to the official Art Blocks MCP and the NFH MCP; each protocol retains its own contracts and any wallet action remains separately approved.

highlight.future_role: External discovery or secondary-market indexing only after the canonical mainnet NFH contract is verified and imported successfully.

opensea.future_role: External indexing, compatible restricted Seaport settlement, MCP discovery, and focused ERC-8257 tool registration after launch verification.

platform_composability.skills_publication_gate: A protocol-neutral preview Skill may be published before mainnet only when it truthfully blocks unverified claim, renderer, and market assertions. Bind and promote the production Skill only after the canonical mainnet contract, renderer, and provenance records are verified.

erc8257.activation_gate: Revalidate the final ERC text, generate origin-bound JCS manifests for the exact production Safe, independently verify their hashes and served bytes, then review every registry transaction in the Safe.

source_of_truth.validation: Release checks must fail if allocation, decision-state, royalty, origin, or activation language diverges from this policy.
